caption: The drawing depicts a small statuette resembling the Statue of Liberty, placed in the center of a plain, off-white or light beige background. The statuette is colored predominantly in gray and brown tones, giving it the appearance of weathered metal or stone, with some areas highlighted in a dull yellow. The figure stands on a tiered rectangular pedestal that features detailed architectural embellishments, and is inscribed with the words "STATUE OF LIBERTY" near the base. The statue itself shows a robed figure with a crown, holding a torch aloft in its right hand and a tablet in its left arm. There is a subtle shadow behind the statuette, indicating a light source coming from the top right. Near the bottom left of the image, the name "h. schulze" is faintly written, presumably the artist's signature. There are three small, circular brown stains scattered on the paper near the pedestal. The composition is centered with significant empty space surrounding the statuette.
title: Penny Bank: Statue of Liberty
